name: Indonesian Tempeh Stir-Fry
ingredients: 150 g tempeh, cut in thin strips
1 cup green beans, cut in 3 cm pieces
3 garlic cloves and 2 red chillies, sliced
1½ tbsp soy sauce and juice of ½ lime
steps: Steam the tempeh for 5 minutes to remove bitterness; pat dry.
Pan-sear the tempeh in the oil for 5 minutes until golden; set aside.
Stir-fry the shallots, garlic and chillies for 1 minute, then add the beans and cabbage for 4 minutes.
Return the tempeh with the soy sauce and coriander and toss for 2 minutes.
Finish with lime juice and basil.
note: Tempeh is fermented soy and a complete protein; it is nut-free, but check labels for peanut cross-contact.
